title: Agents don't log in
description: Our systems were built for humans who log in. Agents act on behalf of someone else, and unless the system knows that, nobody can tell who asked for a change.
text: Our systems were built for humans who log in. Agents don't log in. Generally, agents act on behalf of someone else. That's what delegation is: a task handed over by someone else to an agent. Scenario We transformed our CMS to be more agentic. A user can interact with it using a chat interface and ask questions like "What can I do to improve my site's SEO?". The agent analyses it, creates a plan around it and presents it to the user.
